case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70620.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
sup:70620.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You pointed to labour and material costs behind your offer, and you want volume that fills your capacity. Our options answer that with a contract term twice as long as the one you quoted, so your planning stands on a firmer base.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you the longest-running commitment from us together with a clear, simple set of terms, and it reflects the quality picture below:

On quality:
Your quality was 302 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.52; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.54; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As this goes beyond your own remit, would you please take Option A to the colleague who decides on multi-year agreements? We would like to settle this as a fair solution for both family companies.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position.

Our Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

As an alternative, we have reviewed your options and can accommodate the 24-month contract with 45-day payment terms at a unit price of €4.90, specifically a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, please understand that as a matter of company policy, we do not disclose our internal cost structures. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. This offer represents our firm position based on current market conditions and ensures the continued reliability of our supply. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You told us that the figures behind your calculation are not something you can share, and that your position is firm. We respect that, and we do not ask you to open your books.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you the longest-running commitment from us on clear, simple terms, which makes it the easiest of the three to carry through on your side.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.62; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.59; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As this is a renewal between two family-minded companies, we would like to settle it in one clean step. Since you may need sign-off on your side, please take Option A to the person who decides, so that we can close this soon.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and your preference for Option A. As your reliable partner, we are always eager to support your requirements and keep our strong relationship growing. 

For our main Angebot, we can offer a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Alongside this, we can also present an alternative package: to confirm the 24-month contract with 45-day payment terms, we require a unit price of EUR 4.89. This represents our limit for these terms and ensures we can maintain our service standards. As a second option, this package provides a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
